# `testgen` command

Generate a test program for the public procedures of a module: a compile-checked skeleton from facts, completed by
the LLM, built and run in a scratch copy of the project, and kept only when it builds, runs and checks something.

```bash
fobis testgen MODULE [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [AI assistance](/cookbook/ai).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

Arguments: `MODULE`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--src`, `-s` | TEXT |  | Root-directory of source files [default: ./] |
| `--procedure`, `-p` | TEXT |  | Test only this public procedure or generic (repeatable). |
| `--max` | INTEGER |  | Test at most this many procedures [default: 8 with the model, all with --skeleton]. |
| `--skeleton` |  |  | No model: the compile-checked skeleton (declarations and calls, no checks) only. |
| `--context` |  |  | Print what the model would receive, run no model. |
| `--apply` |  |  | Write the accepted program to the test directory (fobos [test] test_dir, default test/) as test_&lt;module&gt;.f90; an existing file is never overwritten. |
| `--output`, `-o` | TEXT |  | Write the accepted program to this path (implies --apply). |
| `--retries` | INTEGER | `3` | Attempts after the first one, each with the errors of the previous. |
| `--timeout` | FLOAT | `60.0` | Seconds a test program may run. |
| `--format` | TEXT | `text` | Output format: text or json. |

<!-- cli:end -->
